subject: Renewal pricing: staircase anchoring & monthly true-up proposal
messages:
From: Sara Chen <sara.chen@novushealth.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 21 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal planning and mid-cycle expansion

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We are planning for a mid-year expansion: team expects ~2.5x token usage for the next 6 months as we roll the summarization feature to 40% more clients. Procurement asked me to get a concrete renewal/expansion path from you by EOW so they can align the PO and budget.

Two specific asks:
- An uplift pricing approach that lets us step into higher commit levels without renegotiating every month (something predictable for finance).
- An option to co-term the new capacity with our existing annual contract (currently expires 2027-02-15).

I attached a usage extract for Q1 to help. We're sensitive to headline unit cost — they will want to see anchoring math for any discount.

Can you send options (annualize vs staircase with monthly true-up), and an initial anchor discount we can take to procurement?

Cheers,
Sara
Sara Chen
Senior Product Manager, NovusHealth

From: olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com
To: Sara Chen <sara.chen@novushealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal planning and mid-cycle expansion

Hi Sara — thanks for the data and context. High level options below; I attached a detailed offer PDF with the rate math and the monthly true-up mechanics.

1) Annualize (fast-track):
   - Convert the uplift to an annualized add-on billed monthly.
   - 15% off list for a 1.5x uplift commit (best for predictable budgeting).

2) Staircase anchoring + monthly true-up (recommended for phased rollouts):
   - Anchor discount of 10% at initial uplift band (1.25x).
   - Step to 15% once usage exceeds 1.75x for a rolling 30-day window.
   - Monthly true-up: actual usage billed at the stepped rates with a reconciliation at month end; no retroactive price resets beyond reconciliation.
   - Co-term: we can co-term the uplift to your 2027-02-15 renewal; unused committed tokens will carry forward per our standard carry-forward policy (up to 30 days).

3) Short-term bridge + commitment credit:
   - If you need immediate burst capacity, we can provide a 60-day bridge with a 5% credit applied to the first month of the committed uplift.

I've highlighted the staircase option in the PDF because it reduces procurement friction while keeping Redwood's unit economics intact for us.

Attachments: Renewal-Offer-v3.pdf (PDF, 142KB) — includes sample invoice calendar and HubSpot deal link for reference.

Next step: if procurement is comfortable with the staircase anchoring + monthly true-up, I can route an amended SOW for signature and create the HubSpot amendment. If they want annualization instead, we'll walk them through the annualized billing mechanics and the effective blended rate.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Context: Novus is strategic in payer workflows; good try at expansion and they are likely to pull additional eval workloads. I think staircase + monthly true-up balances predictability and our economics.

Thanks — Olga

Olga — authorize up to 15% on the top stair for renewals only (no stacking with other promotional credits). Approve 10% anchor on sign for the 1.25x band; step to 15% at 1.75x as long as the 30-day rolling average holds. Keep carry-forward at 30 days.

Subject: Revised offer: Staircase anchor + monthly true-up (NB-1247)

Sara / Procurement team — attaching the revised offer per the internal approvals. Summary of the final terms in plain language below: 

- Anchor band (1.25x uplift): 10% off list.
- Top stair (>=1.75x uplift rolling 30-day average): 15% off list.
- Monthly true-up: usage billed each month at staired rates; month-end reconciliation adjusts charge to the appropriate stair.
- Carry-forward: up to 30 days for unused committed tokens.
- Bridge: optional 60-day burst with 5% credit applied to month 1 if you need immediate capacity before amendment is signed.
- Co-term: uplift will co-term to existing expiry (2027-02-15); amendment will show pro-rata alignment.

Attached: Renewal-Offer-v3.pdf (rate tables + example invoices). HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/67890. DocuSign draft (SOW amendment) included for signature when procurement confirms.

Please confirm whether procurement wants (A) the staircase anchor with monthly true-up and co-term, or (B) annualize the uplift into a simple monthly blended invoice. If A, I'll trigger the DocuSign flow and email the amended SOW; if B, I'll push the annualized rate and adjust the deal math.

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
